name: apprenti.dev Backend Engineering Apprenticeship
audience: Junior to mid-level developers who already know how to program, specializing into backend service engineering
philosophy: Evidence-driven apprenticeship: design, build, test, operate and defend one coherent backend service.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints and quizzes.
The apprentice remains accountable for every submitted artifact.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated understanding, not AI output quality.
